namespace = kosmo_japanpu_events

# Royal Marriage toki Subject
country_event = {
	id = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303
	title = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.t
	desc = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_MENU_7C_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				tag = TKI
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = kosmo_japanpu_events.73098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = kosmo_japanpu_events.73098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = kosmo_japanpu_events.73098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.7303.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage toki Subject
country_event = {
	id = kosmo_japanpu_events.7301
	title = kosmo_japanpu_events.7301.t
	desc = kosmo_japanpu_events.7301.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_MENU_7C_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
				superregion = far_east_superregion
			}
			set_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
				superregion = far_east_superregion
			}
			set_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
						superregion = far_east_superregion
						has_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.7301.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = toki_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_ooku_7c
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = kosmo_japanpu_events.73031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = toki_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = toki_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = toki_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

					}

		}

		}

					}
				}

					}

	id = kosmo_japanpu_events.12119
	title = kosmo_japanpu_events.12119.t
	desc = kosmo_japanpu_events.12119.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_MENU_12A_1_eventPicture

	
	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = ashikaga_heir_honeymoon
	NOT = {
		has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
	}
		}

	
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 7
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = ashikaga_heir_honeymoon
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				tag = ASK
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.12119.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				tag = ASK
			}
				overlord = {
					define_consort = {
						country_of_origin = PREV
						religion = PREV
						culture = PREV
					}
				}
		}		
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_ooku_12a
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoOokuTwelveACounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoOokuTwelveACounter
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoOokuTwelveACounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}	
}

# Palace menu
country_event = {
	id = kosmo_japanpu_events.1220
	title = kosmo_japanpu_events.1220.t
	desc = kosmo_japanpu_events.1220.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_MENU_12B_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes
		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_known_country = {
			limit = {
			has_opinion_modifier = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_visiting_palace
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = palacecountry
				capital_scope = {
					set_province_flag = cosmo_forbidden_palace
				}		
		}
				random_list = {#army
				40 = { #fraud
						set_country_flag = hosokawa_army_fraud
				}
				40 = { #genuine
						set_country_flag = hosokawa_army_genuine
	
				}
				20 = { #toogood
						set_country_flag = hosokawa_army_toogood
				}																								
			}
				random_list = {#unrest
				40 = { #fraud
						set_ruler_flag = cosmo_unrest_fraud
				}
				40 = { #genuine
						set_ruler_flag = cosmo_unrest_genuine
	
				}
				20 = { #toogood
						set_ruler_flag = cosmo_unrest_toogood
				}																								
			}																		
		}
	}	

		option = {#Hosokawa
		name = kosmo_japanpu_events.1220.a
		if = {
			limit = {
			exists = HSK				
			OR = {
				any_known_country = { #shared pic
				tag = HSK	
					cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}
			HSK = {
				NOT = {
					is_subject = yes 
				}	
				}				
			}							
				}
			HSK = {
				add_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_rescued_princess
				}	
				}										
			}		
		if = {
			limit = {
			exists = HSK				
			NOT = {
				any_known_country = { #shared pic
				tag = HSK	
					cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}
			}
				HSK = {
					is_subject = yes 
				}							
				}
				HSK = {
					overlord = {
				set_ruler_flag = cosmo_hosokawa_rebels
				country_event = {
					id = kosmo_japanpu_events.12213
						days = 60
						random = 365	
				}						
					}
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I	
					subject = HSK	
					}
				country_event = {#royal wedding
					id = kosmo_japanpu_events.12203
					}									
			}					
		if = {
			limit = {
		NOT = {	#rebel country
			exists = HSK
			}				
			NOT = {
				any_known_country = { #shared pic
				tag = HSK	
					cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}
			}				
				}
				1021 = {
					add_core = HSK
					cede_province = HSK
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I	
					subject = HSK	
					}
				country_event = {#royal wedding
					id = kosmo_japanpu_events.12203
					}
			event_target:palacecountry = {
				set_ruler_flag = cosmo_hosokawa_rebels
				country_event = {
					id = kosmo_japanpu_events.12213
						days = 60
						random = 365	
				}			
			}
		hidden_effect = {
		trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		cosmo_unrest_fraud = {
			1021 = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_pretender_charlatan
			duration =  7300
			desc = cosmo_pretender_charlatan_DESC
			}
			ROOT = { add_adm_power = -150  }
			ROOT = { add_mil_power = -150  }
			}
			}
		cosmo_unrest_genuine = {
			1021 = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_pretender_competent
			duration =  7300
			desc = cosmo_pretender_competent_DESC
			}
			ROOT = { add_adm_power = -100  }
			ROOT = { add_mil_power = -100  }			
			}
			}
		cosmo_unrest_toogood = {
			1021 = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_pretender_best
			duration =  7300
			desc = cosmo_pretender_best_DESC
			}
			ROOT = { add_adm_power = -50  }
			ROOT = { add_mil_power = -50  }

		option = {#cancel
